dedup.scope: Targeted neighbours only: every public item whose record mentions jep.142, associahedra, Loday realizations, diagonal maps, polytopal subdivisions, normal fans or Tamari, the retired-claims list, the preparation worklist, and the geometry scouting selection/block notes for this source. No global novelty claim.
compared: public 2039 (same source): counted unit Theorem 1 / thm:MainOperad, statement 1303-1309 and proof 1311-1337. That proof invokes prop:Transition at line 1312, but the transition-map statement and its complete proof (1185-1273) are outside the counted spans, and the operad axioms are a different conclusion from existence/uniqueness/invertibility of tr.

prepared A-2039-associahedral-magic-formula (same source, state published): counted unit thm:MagicFormula (statement 1343-1380, proofs 515-755 / 833-1044 / 1390-1660); an explicit matching-face formula for standard Loday realizations, disjoint from lines 1166-1180 and 1185-1273 of this task. Its proof region supplies only declared prerequisite context here (def:Diag, coherent-subdivision construction, def:Coherent, Lemma:DiagOnFace, cor:DIMENSION).

source corollary at lines 1275-1282 ('any two normally equivalent polytopes positively oriented by the same vector are isomorphic in PolySub') is deliberately not counted: it is a direct corollary of Prop:NormalFan and prop:Transition.

public 1792 'Permutree fans are normal fans of explicit deleted-inequality permutreehedra for arbitrary four-type decorations' (doi:10.5802/alco.1, Theorem 3.4): realisation of a different polytope family by normal fans; no transition map and no subdivision isomorphism.

public 198918 (arxiv:2604.20250, thm:gkz:complete) and public 201338 (arxiv:2605.25229, lem:f-word-normalization): polytopal-subdivision and polytopal-projection statements with different objects and conclusions.
